sub: A permissive mock identity service that speaks sixteen protocol families. It exists to exercise CLIENTS.
warn: It checks no password, validates no access token and attests no workload. Do not put this port on a public address.
repoNote: The source, the README, and the sixteen families in full.
issuesNote: What is known to be wrong, and where to say what is not.
docsNote: The GitHub Pages site: getting started, configuration, and what is deliberately not checked.
consoleLabel: The admin console on this instance
consoleNote: Everything this process has done, and the settings that change what its protocol endpoints do.
consoleRoles: It also asks for one of two roles.
consoleOpen: It is open on this instance.
consoleMetadata: Every endpoint this service registered is listed inside it, at /admin/sts-metadata.
portalLabel: The user portal on this instance
portalNote: The account pages of whoever is looking at them: how they sign in to this service, what it holds about them, and where it will sign them in.
portalNoRole: It asks for no role, which is the whole difference from the console above: every page of it is about the person looking at it, so saying who you are is the entire question.
signInProduct: It asks you to sign in, and this instance is in product mode, so the password is checked against the account.
signInDevelopment: It asks you to sign in — any username, and no password is checked.
